summary: A new Community installation now finishes, exactly as the README describes.

fixes.title: Community installations finish
fixes.text: A new Community installation no longer stops half-way. It now completes and checks itself: the Manager runs, the page answers behind sign-in and the engine job exists.

fixes.title: The README install command works
fixes.text: The install command in the README now names who may sign in to the Manager, which is required. A dry run tells you if it is missing.
